integrity: All conclusions are proved analytically from the quotient construction, mixing, proximality, and published generic-factor lemmas. No numerical experiment, exhaustive search, or external certification is used. A residual literature risk remains because the arbitrary-cycle extension is elementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats finite cyclic sheet wedges over the specific proximal mixing base used in the source. It does not classify all endpoint shadowing E-systems or all maximal equicontinuous generic factors, and it asserts maximality only in the generic-factor category.
title: Prescribed finite cyclic generic factors at the lower-density shadowing endpoint
